# SCDA Android renderer reference

Unmodified MIT-licensed source subset from https://github.com/mogeldev/SCDA-XBERecomp-android/tree/a81808004c397cbee282031933cdda2972ffad4e. See LICENSE. Includes the original shader generator and matching state/vertex declarations, Vulkan memory/fence/descriptor/barrier helpers, and its upstream renderer regression suite. This is an isolated compilation reference, **not linked into the APK**, and does not contain game assets. The Hulk runtime's newer GPU state and guarded guest memory access remain authoritative. Do not link the two sets of gpu:: symbols into the same executable. The full upstream Vulkan backend has SDL3, app settings, driver loading, GPU state and guest-memory dependencies and is not a drop-in replacement. The experimental CMake targets compile both the reference suite and the current Hulk shader generator independently.
